example.py.title: Minimal Task
example.py.summary: Smallest useful qym example showing a task function, metrics, and evaluator wiring.
prerequisites: Have a small dataset name available, or adapt the task to a local CSV flow.
what_it_shows: How qym resolves task function arguments such as `model_name` and `trace_id`.
How built-in and custom metrics can live in the same run.
How local execution can still stream into the platform if platform env vars are set.
example.py.run: qym run create --task-file examples/example.py --task-function my_task --dataset my-set --metrics exact_match
example.py.expected_outcome: A completed run with item-level metric output and a local results artifact under `qym_results/`.

csv_dataset_eval.py.title: CSV Dataset Evaluation
csv_dataset_eval.py.summary: Run evaluations against a local CSV dataset with no remote dataset dependency.
prerequisites: Prepare a CSV file with at least an input column and an expected output column.
what_it_shows: How to use `CsvDataset` for local and air-gapped evaluation.
How to keep the evaluation loop working even without Langfuse datasets.
csv_dataset_eval.py.run: qym run create --task-file examples/csv_dataset_eval.py --task-function my_task --dataset-csv ./qa.csv --metrics exact_match,fuzzy_match
csv_dataset_eval.py.expected_outcome: A local evaluation completes with deterministic metrics and can optionally be uploaded later with `qym submit`.

rag_eval.py.title: RAG Evaluation
rag_eval.py.summary: Evaluate a retrieval-augmented generation flow against a prepared dataset.
prerequisites: Set the model provider environment variables required by your task implementation.
Prepare the referenced dataset before running the script.
what_it_shows: How qym evaluates answer quality and grounding for RAG tasks.
How to run a dataset-backed workflow rather than a toy single-example task.
rag_eval.py.expected_outcome: A run completes with RAG-focused metrics and the results can be reviewed in the platform if configured.

rag_eval_judges.py.title: RAG Judge Metrics
rag_eval_judges.py.summary: Use qym's built-in LLM judges to evaluate RAG output quality.
prerequisites: Set `QYM_JUDGE_MODEL` and a compatible API key or OpenAI-compatible base URL.
what_it_shows: How to switch from hand-written metric logic to built-in judge metrics.
How to point judge evaluation at OpenAI-compatible local or hosted endpoints.
rag_eval_judges.py.expected_outcome: Judge-based metrics populate structured scores, labels, and explanations per item.

multi_model.py.title: Multi-Model Compare
multi_model.py.summary: Run the same task across multiple models and compare results.
prerequisites: Ensure the configured task can route by `model_name` or `model`.
what_it_shows: How to benchmark multiple models against one task and dataset.
How qym keeps the comparison path compatible with later platform review.
multi_model.py.expected_outcome: Multiple model variants are evaluated and become comparable in the platform and CLI.

scale_example.py.summary: Pattern for larger evaluation workloads and async task behavior.
